loginDescription: Sign in with your Circe et Venus account.
loginCardSubtitle: Sign in to continue. Your session is private and encrypted.
loginErrorBadCredentialsTitle: We couldn’t match that email and password.
loginErrorBadCredentialsDetail: Check your details and try again, or reset your password.
loginErrorGenericTitle: Unable to sign in right now.
signUpCardSubtitle: Start with a 2-day trial. A card on file is required to activate billing after the trial.
forgotDescriptionBeforeSent: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotDescriptionAfterSent: If an account exists for this email, we sent a reset link.
forgotAfterSentHint: Click the link in the email to choose a new password. The link may take a few minutes to arrive.
resetExpiredMessage: This link may have expired or already been used. Request a new reset link.
resetErrorMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
forgotSent: Check your email for a recovery link.
signUpSuccessInboxSubtitle: Confirm your email to unlock your workspace.
signUpSuccessInboxBody: We’ve sent a verification link. After you confirm, you’ll return here signed in — then you can add a card to start your trial.
signUpSuccessSpamHintBefore: Spam or promotions folder? Check there too.
signUpSuccessConfirmedSubtitle: Email verified — you’re signed in. One calm step unlocks your trial wallet.
signUpSuccessTrialCreditsTail: AI credits unlock after a card is on file — same secure Stripe flow as billing.
signUpSuccessContinueWithoutCard: Continue without card — I’ll finish later
signUpSuccessTrialActiveBody: Your trial is active. Continue to the dashboard — onboarding will pick up from here.
signUpShowcaseBody: Circe handles retention, protection, and analytics. Venus helps you grow audience and stay on top of fan conversations—side by side in one workspace.
signUpShowcaseRotateHint: Features rotate about every {seconds}s — tap a dot to jump.
mfaLoginSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
mfaLoginErrorDetail: Check the code and try again.
mfaLoginErrorNoFactor: We couldn’t find an active authenticator for this account.
mfaLoginErrorLoadFactors: We couldn’t load your security settings. Try again in a moment.
